errors.message: This must be an INTEGER, but it is a REAL
errors.hint: An index is a whole number, e.g. Scores[0].

notes: Wording for E-CHK-NEEDS-INTEGER in Edexcel (first version, for review in docs/review/M2.md). (index variant). Indexes count elements from 0 (EDX-22), so they are whole numbers.
